name: Skillscout
summary: A SwiftUI Mac app and a skillscout command that list the skills of 8 coding agents, count how often chats use them, and ask AI for new skill ideas.

overview.name: You
overview.summary: Look through your skills, share them between agents and ask for new ones

overview.name: The app on your Mac
overview.summary: Lists every skill your coding agents can load, and how often you use each one

overview.name: The skillscout command
overview.summary: Does the same from the terminal, so agents can use it too

overview.name: The skill finder
overview.summary: Finds every skill, counts how often your chats use it, and spots skills that look alike

overview.name: The AI helper
overview.summary: Asks an AI agent for skill ideas and drafts when you want new ones

overview.name: Your agents' folders
overview.summary: Where the skills and your chat histories live

edges.label: browses skills
edges.note: Clicks through the window: skills by agent, by use, and similar pairs

edges.label: runs commands
edges.note: Runs skillscout in Terminal, or an agent runs it for you

edges.label: reads state
edges.note: SwiftUI views observe the @Observable store and redraw when it changes

edges.label: starts watching
edges.note: Starts one FSEvents stream for all the skills folders at launch

edges.label: scans skills
edges.note: Rescans the skills folders at launch and after each change event

edges.label: counts usage
edges.note: Parses new chat lines in the background and updates the use counts

edges.label: adds skills
edges.note: Adds, renames, merges or uninstalls a skill when you choose it in the window

edges.label: asks AI
edges.note: Asks for ideas, a draft or an explanation, and waits for the answer

edges.label: saves state
edges.note: Writes state.json atomically after every change you make

edges.label: checks releases
edges.note: Asks for the latest release once a day, and downloads its zip when you accept

edges.label: watches
edges.note: FSEvents on each agent's skills folder, debounced so a burst triggers one rescan

edges.label: lists skills
edges.note: skillscout list scans the folders fresh on every run

edges.label: counts usage
edges.note: skillscout usage parses the chats, reusing the app's cache when it's there

edges.label: adds skills
edges.note: add, rename, merge and uninstall go through the same installer as the app

edges.label: suggests, explains
edges.note: skillscout suggest and explain build the same prompts as the window

edges.label: reads SKILL.md
edges.note: Reads each SKILL.md and parses its YAML frontmatter for the name and description

edges.label: parses chats
edges.note: Reads JSONL transcripts and SQLite chat databases, only what was added since the last pass

edges.label: caches parses
edges.note: Caches parsed chats, so the next launch only reads what's new

edges.label: links skills
edges.note: Links or copies the skill folder into the other agent's skills folder

edges.label: sends prompts
edges.note: Hands over the prompt and parses the JSON that comes back

edges.label: runs headless
edges.note: Runs codex exec or claude -p as a child process with the login shell PATH
